name: chronos
description: Launch a local Codex workflow dashboard with one setup prompt, isolated task execution, optional outcome and tool-call learning, and Windows diagnostics.

interface.longDescription: Describe your goal and select framework files or a folder. Your setup chat prepares a paused Chronos Control Room workflow with clear handoffs and human review gates. Choose models and supported thinking levels per stage, with task-based suggestions and hover/focus help. Design visual workflows with bot pools, inboxes, outboxes, joins, isolated workspace writes and native checks. Optional learning pipelines propose improvements from completed workflows without silently applying them. Uses a local Codex executor and Node 22+; Windows diagnostics and existing-chat Governor monitoring remain separate opt-ins. No publisher telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Set up Control Room from my goal and framework. Suggest models and thinking. Explain privacy and permissions; open paused.
Review my completed workflow with outcome learning and tool-call analysis; propose improvements without applying them.
Run a Control Room health check; optionally include Windows diagnostics with my consent.
